info.title: Consola Cloud regional cell
info.description: What a workspace holds in its region. Every route but the health check, the outbox's deliveries and the GitHub events cloud-global passes on takes a cell token, minted by cloud-global for one workspace (`Authorization: Bearer`), and reads and writes that workspace alone.

Caller.description: Who is asking, as their checked cell token says.

canManage.description: Whether the caller may make, rename and delete teams, and choose their members.

TeamList.description: The teams the caller sees: every team for owners and admins, the ones they are in for a member.

first.description: Whether it is the workspace's first team, which every new member joins and which is never deleted.

memberIds.description: Its members’ global ids, in the order they joined it.

InvalidTeam.description: Every problem with the name, at once.

TeamName.description: A name (trimmed, 1 to 64 characters, no control characters), unique in the workspace whatever its case.

FactoryList.description: The factories the caller sees, by name: every factory for owners and admins, the factories of the teams they are in for a member.

latestVersion.description: Its latest version's number: 1 until its files are first saved, and one more with each save.

updatedAt.description: When its latest version was saved, as an ISO 8601 time.

FactorySource.description: Where the factory's files come from: `stored`, saved in the cell. A GitHub repository comes later.

InvalidFactory.description: Every problem with the name, at once.

NewFactory.description: A name (trimmed, 1 to 64 characters, no control characters), unique in the workspace whatever its case, and the id of the team that owns it.

FactoryWithFiles.description: A factory, and its latest version with its files.

savedAt.description: When it was saved, as an ISO 8601 time.

savedBy.description: The global id of the person who saved it.

FactoryVersion.description: One version of a factory's files, as saved.

path.description: Its path inside the factory's folder: `factory.yml`, `automations/<name>.yaml`, `agents/<name>.md`, `skills/<name>/…`.

name.description: Its new name (trimmed, 1 to 64 characters, no control characters), unique in the workspace whatever its case.

teamId.description: The id of the team that owns it from now on.

FactoryChange.description: What changes, at least one of the two: both at once is one change, made whole or not at all. Its files and where they come from are not changed here.

SavedFactoryVersion.description: The version saved, and what to know about it.

FactoryNotice.description: Something the factory schema says about the files that refuses nothing, such as a folder a later slice reads.

InvalidFiles.description: Files that fail the factory schema: every problem, each naming its file. Nothing is saved.

file.description: The file the problem is in; absent for a problem with the set as a whole.

path.description: Where in the file, as a dotted path into its document (`automations[0].mode`); empty for the whole file.

automation.description: The automation the problem belongs to, when it has a name.

cause.description: The file (or skill's folder) whose own problems this one only shows through: a step's agent, an agent's skill.

FactoryIssue.description: A problem with the files, as the factory schema words it.

VersionMoved.description: The latest version is no longer `baseVersion`: someone saved since. Nothing is saved.

baseVersion.description: The version the files were edited from, which must still be the latest: a save never undoes one it did not see.

files.description: Every file of the new version (at most 500, 8 MB in all): a file left out is not in it.

items.description: The agent CLI the session runs.

CloudSessionOptions.description: What the workspace's connected runner offers: where a session can start, and with what.

personId.description: The global id of the person who started it, the only one who sees it.

harness.description: The agent CLI the session runs.

status.description: `starting` goes to `running` or `failed`, and `running` to `stopped` or `failed`; `stopped` and `failed` are ends.

hostUrl.description: The origin the session's host listens on, once the runner reported it.

error.description: The message the runner reported for a failure (its provider’s or its start script’s), shown as it came. A failed session has this or `errorCode`, never both.

errorCode.description: A failure the cell decided itself, which the web app words: the runner restarted, could not be reached, or failed without a message.

runnerId.description: The runner the start was handed to.

createdAt.description: When it was started, in epoch seconds.

endedAt.description: When it ended, in epoch seconds; null while it lives.

CloudSession.description: A person's cloud session: a sandbox the workspace's runner runs for them.

repository.description: One the runner offers, as `owner/name`; its name may not start with a dot.

harness.description: The agent CLI the session runs.

NewCloudSession.description: Exactly these two fields: a body naming anything else, a workspace above all, is refused.

pass.description: The session pass, a compact JWS signed with the cell's own key, which the session's host checks.

hostUrl.description: The origin the session's host listens on.

expiresAt.description: When the pass expires, in epoch seconds: its `exp`.

get.summary: Whether the cell can reach its database, and which region it serves
get.description: Needs no token: it says nothing a workspace holds.

503.description: It cannot.

post.summary: Deliver one of cloud-global's outbox messages
post.description: Only cloud-global calls it. The body is the message, signed as a compact JWS with the cell token’s key (`packages/cloud-contract`, "Delivering a message"), so it takes no token.

200.description: The cell has the message: applied now, or before.

400.description: Not sent as a signed message, over the size a message can be, or not a message the contract reads.

401.description: Not signed by cloud-global.

409.description: Messages before this one are missing: the sequence of the workspace's message the cell applies next.

421.description: A message about a workspace in another region.

503.description: The cell cannot get cloud-global's keys or its database.

post.summary: Deliver one of GitHub’s webhook events, passed on by cloud-global
post.description: Only cloud-global calls it, for a workspace whose GitHub installation the event came through. The body is the event, signed as a compact JWS with the cell token’s key (`packages/cloud-contract`, "Passing on a GitHub event"), so it takes no token. The cell records each delivery once, by GitHub’s id of it.

200.description: The cell had recorded the event before: a delivery sent again, which changed nothing.

201.description: The cell recorded the event now.

400.description: Not sent as a signed event, over the size an event can be, or not an event the contract reads.

401.description: Not signed by cloud-global as an event.

409.description: The cell does not hold the workspace yet: cloud-global has not delivered its creation.

421.description: An event for a workspace in another region.

503.description: The cell cannot get cloud-global's keys or its database.

get.summary: Who is asking, as this cell sees them

401.description: No bearer token (`token_required`), or one the cell does not accept (`invalid_token`): malformed, forged, expired, or signed by a key cloud-global does not publish. A new token is the fix.

421.description: A good token for a workspace in another region: the cell that answered names its own. The workspace's own cell is the fix.

503.description: The cell cannot get cloud-global's keys just now, so it checks no token.

patch.summary: Rename a factory, or move it to another team
patch.description: Whoever sees the factory may rename it. Moving it needs the caller to see the team it moves to as well: owners and admins any team, a member a team they are in. Its versions stay as they are.

400.description: The rules refuse the name, or the body is not what the route takes: neither a name nor a team is one.

401.description: No bearer token (`token_required`), or one the cell does not accept (`invalid_token`): malformed, forged, expired, or signed by a key cloud-global does not publish. A new token is the fix.

404.description: The caller sees no such factory (`factory_not_found`), or no such team to move it to (`team_not_found`): none, or one a member is not in.

409.description: Another factory of the workspace has the name, in any case (`name_taken`), or the cell does not hold the workspace yet (`workspace_pending`).

415.description: The body is not JSON (`Content-Type: application/json`).

421.description: A good token for a workspace in another region: the cell that answered names its own. The workspace's own cell is the fix.

503.description: The cell cannot get cloud-global's keys just now, so it checks no token.

post.description: The files must keep the factory schema (`packages/factory-spec`), and `baseVersion` must still be the latest version. Whoever sees the factory may save it.

409.description: The factory has a newer version than the one the files were edited from (`version_moved`), or the cell does not hold the workspace yet.

413.description: The body is larger than any factory’s files can be.

get.summary: What the workspace's runner offers a new session

401.description: No bearer token (`token_required`), or one the cell does not accept (`invalid_token`): malformed, forged, expired, or signed by a key cloud-global does not publish. A new token is the fix.

421.description: A good token for a workspace in another region: the cell that answered names its own. The workspace's own cell is the fix.

503.description: No runner is configured or connected for the workspace (`no_runner`). Or the cell cannot get cloud-global's keys just now, so it checks no token (`token_check_unavailable`).

post.summary: Start a cloud session on the workspace’s runner
post.description: Nothing is recorded or sent unless the connected runner offers both the repository and the harness. The session starts as `starting`; the runner moves it on.

201.description: The session, recorded and handed to the runner.

400.description: The runner does not offer the repository (`repository_not_offered`) or the harness (`harness_not_offered`), or the body is not exactly `{ repository, harness }`, each valid (`invalid_request`).

401.description: No bearer token (`token_required`), or one the cell does not accept (`invalid_token`): malformed, forged, expired, or signed by a key cloud-global does not publish. A new token is the fix.

415.description: The body is not JSON (`Content-Type: application/json`).

421.description: A good token for a workspace in another region: the cell that answered names its own. The workspace's own cell is the fix.

503.description: No runner is configured or connected for the workspace (`no_runner`): nothing was recorded. Or the cell cannot get cloud-global's keys just now, so it checks no token (`token_check_unavailable`).

401.description: No bearer token (`token_required`), or one the cell does not accept (`invalid_token`): malformed, forged, expired, or signed by a key cloud-global does not publish. A new token is the fix.

421.description: A good token for a workspace in another region: the cell that answered names its own. The workspace's own cell is the fix.

get.summary: One of the caller’s own cloud sessions

401.description: No bearer token (`token_required`), or one the cell does not accept (`invalid_token`): malformed, forged, expired, or signed by a key cloud-global does not publish. A new token is the fix.

404.description: The caller has no such session: none, another person's or another workspace's, as if it did not exist.

421.description: A good token for a workspace in another region: the cell that answered names its own. The workspace's own cell is the fix.

503.description: The cell cannot get cloud-global's keys just now, so it checks no token.

post.summary: Stop one of the caller’s own cloud sessions
post.description: The session ends at once, whether or not its runner is connected; the runner is told when it is. Stopping an ended session changes nothing.

202.description: The session, ended: `stopped`, or the end it had already.

401.description: No bearer token (`token_required`), or one the cell does not accept (`invalid_token`): malformed, forged, expired, or signed by a key cloud-global does not publish. A new token is the fix.

404.description: The caller has no such session: none, another person's or another workspace's, as if it did not exist.

421.description: A good token for a workspace in another region: the cell that answered names its own. The workspace's own cell is the fix.

503.description: The cell cannot get cloud-global's keys just now, so it checks no token.

post.summary: A pass to one of the caller’s own running sessions
post.description: The pass lasts five minutes (the runner protocol's cap); ask for another when it runs out. No answer of the route is kept by a cache (`Cache-Control: no-store`) but the token check's.

200.description: The pass, and the host it opens.

401.description: No bearer token (`token_required`), or one the cell does not accept (`invalid_token`): malformed, forged, expired, or signed by a key cloud-global does not publish. A new token is the fix.

404.description: The caller has no such running session whose host has an address: none, one still starting or ended, another person's or another workspace's.

421.description: A good token for a workspace in another region: the cell that answered names its own. The workspace's own cell is the fix.

503.description: The cell has no pass key, and so no runner (`no_runner`). Or the cell cannot get cloud-global's keys just now, so it checks no token (`token_check_unavailable`).
